title: EmitIrInput
description:
Subset of the public TS `IR` shape consumed by SVG emission.

`drawOrder` and `warnings` are intentionally omitted: neither affects the
paint scene. Keeping this wire type shared prevents the one-shot and
prepared emit paths from drifting.

IrNode.description:
An IR node in the rendering tree.
Serializes flat (kind fields inline next to `nodeId`/`bbox`, plus a
`type` discriminant) to match the TS `IRNode` shape.

layoutBox.description: Allotted text layout box; `bbox` is the aligned measured block.

unitMap.description: Stable paint-unit metadata generated by boundtext for opt-in text.

unitAnimation.description: Raw unit animation semantic retained across frame sampling.

unitAnimationSamples.description: Per-unit actual outline bounds and sampled pose.

oneOf.description: Structural shape with viewport-baked part paths.

BorderRadius.description:
Resolved border radius — uniform or per-corner.
Serializes as the TS union `number | BorderRadii`.

AnimationTransform2D.description:
Transform channels allowed in animation keyframes. Animation origins are
fixed to the logical node center and are therefore intentionally absent.

HandlersRef.description: Event handler references (string identifiers for hit testing).

Gradient.description:
Parsed CSS gradient.
Serializes as the TS gradient union (`{ type: "linear" | "radial", ... }`).

angle.description: Angle in degrees (CSS convention: 0 = to top, 90 = to right).

geometry.description:
Present for gradients produced by the layout pipeline. Optional so
previously-authored IR keeps the CSS default geometry at emission.

RadialGradientGeometry.description: Resolved radial-gradient geometry in local gradient-box coordinates.

StrokeScaling.description:
Whether a supported stroke scales with post-layout transforms or remains
stable in canvas user space.

LineWire.description: Exact deserialize view accepted by `emit_svg_from_ir` for one line.

GlyphInfo.description:
Single glyph info returned to TS.
Also deserializable: the boundsvg SVG emitter parses TS-produced IR JSON
whose text lines embed this shape.

LineFragmentWire.description: Exact deserialize view accepted by `emit_svg_from_ir` for one fragment.

TextRunStyle.description:
Style information for a text run fragment.
Carried on each `LineFragment` so the SVG emitter can set per-fragment
font-family, font-size, color, etc.

Field names match the canonical TS `TextRunStyle` interface
(`packages/core/src/text/types.ts`).

font.description: Primary font alias (first element of font-family chain).

fallback.description: Fallback font aliases (remaining elements of font-family chain).

fontVariationSettings.description:
Font variation settings string (e.g. `"wght" 700`).
Populated from `VNode` props via enriched input.

color.description:
Per-fragment color. Populated from `VNode` props via enriched input;
`None` means inherit from the parent Text node's color.

TextStrokeLayer.description:
Canonical wire representation of one text outline layer.

This type is shared by boundtext input/output and boundsvg IR so serde
optionality cannot drift between carriers.

TextShadowLayer.description: Canonical wire representation of one text drop-shadow layer.

sourceStart.description:
Grapheme range in the logical base text. Unlike `cluster_*`, these
offsets remain stable across rich-text runs. Ruby annotations point to
the range of the base text they annotate.

inlineScale.description:
Additive scale along the shaped inline axis, applied before baseline
rotation. Absent and `1` are canonical-equivalent.

syntheticKind.description:
Identifies glyphs synthesized by layout rather than sourced from the
authored text.

TextOutlinePath.description:
A text run resolved to glyph outline paths.
Mirrors TS `TextOutlinePath` (`packages/core/src/text/types.ts`).

unitId.description: Deterministic but opaque. Consumers must not parse this representation.

sourceStart.description:
Logical source range in the base text's segmentation space. Ruby
annotations retain the range of the base text they annotate.

lineId.description: Layout-local line/column identity. It may change after reflow.

TextUnitAnimation.description: Raw text paint-unit animation semantic retained after sampling.

TextUnitAnimationSample.description: Actual outline bounds and sampled pose for one text paint unit.

ShapePathPart.description: One baked part of a shape IR node. Mirrors TS `ShapePathPart`.

ShapePartBounds.description: Viewport-baked bounds of one shape part.

ShapePartPaint.description:
Per-part paint override; unset fields inherit the node paint.
Mirrors the `paint` member of TS `ShapePathPart`.
